findings.defect: Replaces a cry to Holrogu with an unfinished reference to the Khan.
findings.rationale: The speaker calls out 홀로구 by name; the line contains neither a title nor an unfinished phrase.

findings.current: “He asked our left wing to deal with the men climbing the cliffs, since the right wing will keep the enemy from breaking through the gorge head-on.”
findings.defect: Turns the right wing’s task of checking or harrying a frontal assault into a promise to prevent a breakthrough.
findings.rationale: 견제 describes holding the attackers in check, not necessarily stopping their breakthrough outright.
findings.replacement: “He asked our left wing to deal with the men climbing the cliffs, while the right wing keeps the enemy attempting a frontal assault through the gorge in check.”
findings.source: “협곡을 정면 돌파하려는 적들은 우군(右軍)이 견제할 테니, 우리 좌군(左軍)은 절벽을 오르는 자들을 처리해 달라 청하셨습니다.”

findings.current: “Asked? I may be the presiding chair by age, but on a battlefield like this, I follow the general’s orders. Don’t I?”
findings.defect: Makes an awkward claim to a formal-sounding chairmanship where the old man is contrasting seniority by age with the general’s battlefield authority.
findings.rationale: 나이로 따졌을 때 explicitly limits his standing here to age; his point is that the general’s instruction is an order, not a request.
findings.replacement: “Asked? I may be the senior one by age, but on a battlefield like this, I follow the general’s orders. Don’t I?”
findings.source: “청은 무슨. 나이로 따졌을 때는 노부가 좌장(座長)이지만, 지금 같은 전장에서는 장군의 명령대로 따라야지. 안 그런가?”

findings.defect: Drops the officer’s cautious attempt to restate that the commissioner made a request.
findings.rationale: 청하시길 repeats the deferential ‘asked’ that the old man has just challenged, explaining why he interrupts the officer.

findings.current: He was faster than even a master who had reached great skill in the Wall Lizard Technique could follow,
findings.defect: Changes an inability to reproduce the feat into an inability to keep up with him.
findings.rationale: 따라 할 수 없을 만큼 means the master could not do the same thing, not merely that the master could not follow his movement.
findings.replacement: He moved so fast that even a master of the Wall Lizard Technique could not have replicated the feat,
findings.source: 경지에 오른 벽호공(壁虎功)의 고수조차 따라 할 수 없을 만큼 쾌속했고

summary: Several lines alter a spoken name, battlefield responsibilities, hierarchy, or a martial-arts comparison.
